title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY 4.0)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE)
eligibility: Indian citizen aged 15-45 years, minimum 5th/8th pass depending on job role.
key_benefits: 100% Free NSQF-aligned training across 4,500+ PMKK and KVK centers
Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) stipend of ₹3,000 - ₹4,500/month for rural trainees
Government DigiLocker-verified NSQF Level 3-7 certification with national validity
Post-training placement and apprenticeship linkage via National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)

title: Namo Drone Didi Scheme (Kisan Drone Skilling)
title_hi: नमो ड्रोन दीदी योजना (किसान ड्रोन कौशल)
title_mr: नमो ड्रोन दीदी योजना (किसान ड्रोन कौशल्य)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare & MSDE
eligibility: Members of DAY-NRLM Self Help Groups, minimum 10th pass, aged 18+.
key_benefits: 15,000 Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) provided with subsidized agricultural drones
15-day DGCA-approved Remote Pilot training at ICAR-KVKs with free boarding
Trainees earn ₹25,000 - ₹45,000/month by offering custom spraying services to local farmers
Special emphasis on backward and aspirational districts for nano-fertilizer spraying

title: PM-KUSUM Component-B & Surya Mitra Scheme
title_hi: पीएम-कुसुम योजना (घटक-बी) एवं सूर्य मित्र कौशल
title_mr: पीएम-कुसुम योजना (घटक-बी) आणि सूर्य मित्र कौशल्य
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
eligibility: Farmers, rural youth, and ITI holders in electrical/fitter/wireman trades.
key_benefits: Up to 60% government subsidy for individual standalone solar water pumps
Skilling under 'Surya Mitra' (NSQF Level 4) for installation, repair and grid tie-in
Assured self-employment and servicing contracts with DISCOMs and pump vendors
Transforms diesel-dependent backward agriculture into clean, zero-fuel irrigation

title: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME)
eligibility: Traditional artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools.
key_benefits: Covers 18 traditional trades (Weavers, Blacksmiths, Potters, Carpenters, Masons, etc.)
₹500/day stipend during basic (5-7 days) & advanced (15 days) NSQF skilling
Digital e-Voucher of ₹15,000 for purchasing modern toolkit equipment
Collateral-free enterprise credit: ₹1 Lakh (1st tranche) & ₹2 Lakhs (2nd tranche) at 5% interest

title: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
title_hi: प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष्म खाद्य उद्योग उन्नयन योजना (PMFME)
title_mr: प्रधानमंत्री सूक्ष्म अन्न प्रक्रिया उद्योग योजना (PMFME)
eligibility: Individual micro-units, FPOs, Cooperatives, and SHG members in food trades.
key_benefits: 35% capital subsidy (up to ₹10 Lakhs) for micro food processing equipment
₹40,000 per member Seed Capital for working capital & small tools for SHGs
NSQF-aligned training on 'One District One Product' (ODOP) value addition
FSSAI food hygiene licensing support and free marketing linkage via ONDC/NAFED

title: Lakhpati Didi Initiative (DAY-NRLM)
title_hi: लखपति दीदी पहल (दीनदयाल अंत्योदय योजना - NRLM)
title_mr: लखपती दीदी मोहीम (दीनदयाळ अंत्योदय योजना - NRLM)
eligibility: Active members of women Self-Help Groups under DAY-NRLM.
key_benefits: Enables rural women to earn sustainable income of at least ₹1 Lakh per year
Integrated livelihood skilling in dairy, poultry, goatry, mushroom, and organic bio-inputs
Community Investment Fund (CIF) support and bank credit linkage via SHG federations
Direct technical handholding by Krishi Sakhi and Pashu Sakhi community cadres
